nodes.label: Cleared vs verified distinction
nodes.rationale: A council saying a job is done is its own word; a fix only counts as verified once independently checked, which makes results trustworthy.

nodes.label: Favicon ?v= cache busting
nodes.rationale: Browsers cache favicons by exact URL; bump ?v= only when the icon file itself changes, not every deploy.

nodes.label: Database-enforced access rules (public may only add and read reports)
nodes.norm_label: database-enforced access rules (public may only add and read reports)
nodes.rationale: Stages, history, responsible bodies and staff accounts are set by the database, never by whoever is asking; verified locally via npm run test:db.

nodes.label: Photo licences/credits unconfirmed before publishing
